Name: Hồ bơi Kikyo Coffee
Note: Nearest of your six but the weakest link in the chain: no hours on Google, no phone to ring, only 6 reviews, and it is a pool attached to a coffee shop at CC EHomeS - cafes rarely open at 06:30. If you start here and it is shut you have no way to have checked first. Detour to #2 is only 0.43 km, so the downside is small, but consider going straight to #2.

Name: Học Bơi Sài Gòn - Hồ Bơi CBD Quận 2
Note: First genuinely reliable stop: Google-confirmed 06:00-20:00, so 30 min of slack before you arrive, 4.5 on 41 reviews. 125 Đồng Văn Cống. Fallback skips #3 deliberately - #3's hours are not trustworthy, so #4 is the next place actually worth riding to. Ring ahead about a single public entry: this is branded as a swim school and the price is unpublished.

Name: Hồ Bơi Thủ Thiêm
Note: Sits between #2 and #4 on the road but do not plan around it: a 24-hour pool listing is almost never real, there are only 3 reviews, and no phone to verify with. Treat it as an opportunistic stop you pass anyway. #4 is only 0.21 km further, so the cost of it being shut is near zero.

Name: Hồ bơi Ánh Viên
Note: The anchor of this chain - make it your default, not your fallback. 569 reviews confirm a genuine Olympic-standard public pool, open 06:00-21:00, price confirmed, phone answers. 523a Đ. Đỗ Xuân Hợp. Every row above it is either unverifiable or unpriced, and it is only 1.13 km past #1. Pay per swim, no monthly pass.

Name: Hồ Bơi Đông Sài Gòn
Note: Solid second anchor and the cheapest confirmed price in your six. Google-confirmed 06:00-20:00, 67 reviews, phone answers. Đường Gò Cát, Long Trường. Note the pool is not divided into lanes - fine for free swimming, poor for timed laps. Only 0.40 km beyond #4, so #4 and #5 together are a safe pair.

Name: Hồ bơi Thảo Điền (Thao Dien Swimming Pool)
Note: End of the chain and the weakest far option - only 5 reviews, price unpublished. It is also the same venue as 'Hồ bơi An Phú' at 8 Thảo Điền, which you filtered out; that listing had 256 reviews and a confirmed 25,000đ entry. You kept the thinner of the two records for one pool. Because there is nothing after this row, ring +84 786 945 678 before committing to a 4.14 km ride.
